defs.d: For the reason (that).
On account (of), for sake (of).
defs.ex: My life is ruined because of you!

defs.d: On account of, because of.
By or for the cause that; on this account that; for the reason that.
defs.ex: I hid myself because I was afraid.

defs.d: As is known, inferred, or determined from the fact that.
defs.ex: I don't think he is a nice person, because he yells at people for no reason.

defs.d: A negative aspect; a downer.
defs.ex: I love almost everything about my job. The only down is that I can't take Saturdays off.

defs.d: A grudge (on someone).
To knock (someone or something) down; to cause to come down, to fell.
defs.ex: A single rifle shot downed the mighty beast.

defs.d: To lower; to put (something) down.
defs.ex: The bell rang for lunch, and the workers downed their tools.

defs.d: Sad, unhappy, depressed, feeling low.
defs.ex: Mary seems very down since she split up with her boyfriend.

defs.d: (normally in the combination 'down with') Sick or ill.
defs.ex: He is down with the flu.

defs.d: To consume (a liquid) through the mouth.
defs.ex: He drank the water I gave him.

defs.d: (metonymic) To consume the liquid contained within (a bottle, glass, etc.).
defs.ex: Jack drank the whole bottle by himself.

defs.d: The sister or sister-in-law of one’s parent.
The female cousin of one’s parent.
Any activity designed to develop or hone a skill or ability.
defs.ex: The teacher told us that the next exercise is to write an essay.

defs.d: Activity intended to improve physical, or sometimes mental, strength and fitness.
defs.ex: I do crosswords for mental exercise.

defs.d: To exert for the sake of training or improvement; to practice in order to develop.
defs.ex: to exercise troops or horses;  to exercise one's brain with a puzzle

defs.d: To perform physical activity for health or training.
defs.ex: I exercise at the gym every day.

defs.d: One who officially belongs to a group.
A part of a whole.
defs.ex: The I-beams were to become structural members of a pedestrian bridge.

defs.d: A limb or appendage that an animal uses for support or locomotion.
defs.ex: {{ux|en|Insects have six legs.}

defs.d: In humans, the lower limb extending from the groin to the ankle.
defs.ex: Dan won't be able to come to the party, since he broke his leg last week and is now on crutches.

defs.d: To remove the legs from an animal carcass.
To build legs onto a platform or stage for support.
A biological structure found in many animals that is used for locomotion and that is frequently a separate organ at the terminal part of the leg.
defs.ex: A spider has eight feet.

defs.d: Specifically, a human foot, which is found below the ankle and is used for standing and walking.
defs.ex: Southern Italy is shaped like a foot.

defs.d: To use the foot to kick (usually a ball).
To pay (a bill).
One who enforces.
The member of a group, especially of a gang, charged with keeping dissident members obedient.
A member of a police force, especially one who is male.
A glass rod capped at one end with rubber, used in a chemistry laboratory for gravimetric analysis.
A brief fall of precipitation (spell of rain, or a similar fall of snow, sleet, or cascade).
defs.ex: Today there will be frequent showers and some sunny spells.

defs.d: A device for bathing by which water is made to fall on the body from a height, either from a tank or by the action of a pump.
(followed by with) To spray with (a specified liquid).
To bathe using a shower.
That place.
That status; that position.
defs.ex: You rinse and de-string the green beans; I'll take it from there.

defs.d: (location) In a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) at some distance from the speaker (compare here).
In that matter, relation, etc.; at that point, stage, etc., regarded as a distinct place.
defs.ex: He did not stop there, but continued his speech.

defs.d: Used as an expletive subject of be in its sense of “exist”, with the semantic, usually indefinite subject being postponed or (occasionally) implied.
defs.ex: Is there an answer? [=Does an answer exist?]

defs.d: Used with other intransitive verbs of existence, in the same sense, or with other intransitive verbs, adding a sense of existence.
defs.ex: If x is a positive number, then there exists [=there is] a positive number y less than x.

defs.d: To change place.
To change in state or status
The period of time that has already happened, in contrast to the present and the future.
defs.ex: a book about a time machine that can transport people back into the past

defs.d: (grammar) The past tense.
Having already happened; in the past; finished.
defs.ex: past glories

defs.d: (postmodifier) Following expressions of time to indicate how long ago something happened; ago.
A regulation, law, guideline.
defs.ex: All participants must adhere to the rules.

defs.d: A ruler; device for measuring, a straightedge, a measure.
To make melancholy; to sadden or grieve (someone).
(heading) Emotionally negative.
Sated, having had one's fill; satisfied, weary.
Any activity that uses physical exertion or skills competitively under a set of rules that is not based on aesthetics.
Something done for fun, regardless of its design or intended purpose.
defs.ex: Joe was banned from getting legal help. He seemed to view lawsuits as a sport.

defs.d: To amuse oneself, to play.
defs.ex: children sporting on the green

defs.d: To mock or tease, treat lightly, toy with.
defs.ex: Jen sports with Bill's emotions.

defs.d: Reason
defs.ex: A good article will cover the who, the what, the when, the where, the why and the how.

defs.d: For what cause, reason, or purpose (interrogative adverb).
For which cause, reason, or purpose (relative adverb).
defs.ex: That's the reason why I did that.

defs.d: An exclamation used to express indignation, mild surprise, or impatience.
An attempt to cause damage, injury to, or death of opponent or enemy.
An attempt to detract from the worth or credibility of, a person, position, idea, object, or thing, by physical, verbal, emotional, or other assault.
defs.ex: They claimed the censorship of the article was an attack on free speech.

defs.d: To apply violent force to someone or something.
defs.ex: This species of snake will only attack humans if it feels threatened.

defs.d: To aggressively challenge a person, idea, etc., with words (particularly in newspaper headlines, because it typesets into less space than "criticize" or similar).
defs.ex: She published an article attacking the recent pay cuts.

defs.d: An electrical engineer.
Related to electricity (or electronics)
Not formal or ceremonious.
defs.ex: an informal get-together

defs.d: Not in accord with the usual regulations.
defs.ex: an informal agreement

defs.d: A rush of water, along a river or onto the land; a flood.
A stream or spring of fresh water.
(commercial fishing) To pack (fish) loosely on ice.
To flood or dilute an area of salt water with flowing fresh water.
Newly produced or obtained; recent.
defs.ex: He followed the fresh hoofprints to find the deer.

defs.d: (of food) Not cooked, dried, frozen, or spoiled.
defs.ex: After taking a beating in the boxing ring, the left side of his face looked like fresh meat.

defs.d: The act of equipping, or the state of being equipped, as for a voyage or expedition.
Whatever is used in equipping something or someone, for example things needed for an expedition or voyage.
Someone who has represented their country in a particular sport.
defs.ex: The United team includes five England internationals.

defs.d: A game or contest between two or more nations.
Of or having to do with more than one nation.
Between or among nations
defs.ex: an international discussion

defs.d: An opening in anything made by breaking or parting.
defs.ex: He made a gap in the fence by kicking at a weak spot.

defs.d: An opening allowing passage or entrance.
defs.ex: We can slip through that gap between the buildings.

defs.d: To notch, as a sword or knife.
To make an opening in; to breach.
A sweet mixture of fruit boiled with sugar and allowed to congeal. Often spread on bread or toast or used in jam tarts.
A difficult situation.
To get something stuck in a confined space.
defs.ex: Her poor little baby toe got jammed in the door.

defs.d: To brusquely force something into a space; cram, squeeze.
defs.ex: The rush-hour train was jammed with commuters.

defs.d: A person with extensive knowledge or ability in a given subject.
defs.ex: We called in several experts on the subject, but they couldn't reach an agreement.

defs.d: A player ranking just below master.
Extraordinarily capable or knowledgeable.
defs.ex: I am expert at making a simple situation complex.

defs.d: Characteristic of an expert.
defs.ex: This problem requires expert knowledge.

defs.d: A young goat.
defs.ex: He treated the oxen like they didn't exist, but he treated the goat kid like a puppy.

defs.d: Of a female goat, the state of being pregnant: in kid.
To make a fool of (someone).
To dupe or deceive (someone).
A chamber used for baking or heating.
To inhale and exhale the smoke from a burning cigarette, cigar, pipe, etc.
defs.ex: He's smoking his pipe.

defs.d: To inhale and exhale tobacco smoke.
defs.ex: Do you smoke?

defs.d: Giving off smoke.
Sexually attractive, usually referring to a woman.
defs.ex: That woman is smoking!

defs.d: An understanding between entities to follow a specific course of conduct.
defs.ex: to enter an agreement;  the UK and US negotiators nearing agreement;  he nodded his agreement.

defs.d: A state whereby several parties share a view or opinion; the state of not contradicting one another.
defs.ex: The results of my experiment are in agreement with those of Michelson and with the law of General Relativity.

defs.d: (Used after a noun or in the predicate) Exceptional, distinct.
defs.ex: a world apart

defs.d: Having been taken apart; disassembled, in pieces.
Placed separately (in regard to space or time).
Separately, exclusively, not together
defs.ex: Consider the two propositions apart.

defs.d: The gases surrounding the Earth or any astronomical body.
The air in a particular place.
A movement in people or things with a particular way in large numbers or amounts
The movement of a real or figurative fluid.
To move as a fluid from one position to another.
defs.ex: Rivers flow from springs and lakes.

defs.d: To proceed; to issue forth.
defs.ex: Wealth flows from industry and economy.

defs.d: A common, inexpensive metal, silvery grey when untarnished, that rusts, is attracted by magnets, and is used in making steel.
A metallic chemical element having atomic number 26 and symbol Fe.
To pass an iron over (clothing or some other item made of cloth) in order to remove creases.
To shackle with irons; to fetter or handcuff.
Made of the metal iron.
Strong (as of will), inflexible.
defs.ex: He held on with an iron grip.

defs.d: A person who writes poems.
A person with a creative or romantic imagination.
Present participle of spend, expenditure.
An amount that has been, or is planned to be spent.
defs.ex: excessive spendings

defs.d: Something set apart for a special use.
(heading) Suitable.
(heading) Possessed, related.
Properly; thoroughly; completely.
Properly.
An artist’s or photographer’s workshop or the room in which an artist works.
defs.ex: His studio was cramped when he began as an artist.

defs.d: An establishment where an art is taught.
defs.ex: As he gained a reputation, he took larger space and took students into his studio,

defs.d: To make (someone) aware of (something impending); especially:
To caution or admonish (someone) against unwise or unacceptable behaviour.
defs.ex: Don't let me catch you running in the corridor again, I warn you.

defs.d: Man-made; of artifice.
defs.ex: The flowers were artificial, and he thought them rather tacky.

defs.d: False, misleading.
defs.ex: Her manner was somewhat artificial.

defs.d: To take by choice into relationship (a child, heir, friend, citizen, etc.)
To take or receive as one's own what is not so naturally.
defs.ex: He adopted a new look in order to fit in with his new workmates.

defs.d: A range of values or locations.
The space, area, volume, etc., to which something extends.
defs.ex: The extent of his knowledge of the language is a few scattered words.

defs.d: Extended.
A homogeneous mass of rock, not layered and without an obvious crystal structure.
defs.ex: karst massives in western Georgia

defs.d: A group of people from a locality, or sharing a collective aim, interest, etc.
defs.ex: Big up to the Croydon massive!

defs.d: Very large in size or extent
defs.ex: Compared to its counterparts from World War II, the Abrams main battle tank is truly massive.

defs.d: Very large or bulky and heavy and solid
defs.ex: A massive comet or asteroid appears to have ended the era of the dinosaurs.

defs.d: A sudden, heavy impact.
defs.ex: The train hit the buffers with a great shock.

defs.d: A discontinuity arising in the solution of a partial differential equation.
To cause to be emotionally shocked, to cause (someone) to feel surprised and upset.
defs.ex: The disaster shocked the world.

defs.d: To give an electric shock to.
A sticky, gummy substance secreted by trees; sap.
defs.ex: It is hard to get this pitch off my hand.

defs.d: A dark, extremely viscous material remaining in still after distilling crude oil and tar.
defs.ex: It was pitch black because there was no moon.

defs.d: To cover or smear with pitch.
To darken; to blacken; to obscure.
Related to the (or any) city.
Characteristic of city life.

Any of a specific group of organic compounds essential in small quantities for healthy human growth, metabolism, development, and body function; found in minute amounts in plant and animal foods or sometimes produced synthetically; deficiencies of specific vitamins produce specific disorders.
To become wise.
Usually with "up", to inform or learn.
defs.ex: After Mo had a word with him, he wised up.

defs.d: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.
defs.ex: "It is a profitable thing, if one is wise, to seem foolish" - Aeschylus

defs.d: Disrespectful.
defs.ex: Don't get wise with me!
